verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a first-party infrastructure agent that it says 'governs, and optimizes' cloud infrastructure, takes plain-English requests, monitors outcomes and investigates incidents. That implies AI-driven analysis of the user's own infrastructure data inside the product, but the evidence never explicitly describes Neo surfacing insights or recommendations. The MCP server serves external assistants and does not count as in-product insight. missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-product AI-generated insights or recommendations drawn from stack/resource data, examples of the suggestions produced, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Neo provisions, governs, and optimizes your cloud infrastructure — with enterprise controls built in.
Investigate incidents and maintain infrastructure with Pulumi Agents
It handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes automatically.
AI built for infrastructure — all in one platform.
